patch_description: Prior generations repeatedly converge near a D6-symmetric structure (two staggered hexagonal rings plus 2 axial points) at ratio ~0.21-0.22, and the feedback notes top programs land *near* but miss this symmetric optimum. The annealed local optimizers only refine within a basin, so adding this structure as an explicit seed — with a small parametric sweep over ring height h (and twist angle) — starts the search directly inside the most promising basin. The seed: for parameters (h, twist), ring 1 at z=+h with angles 0°,60°,..., ring 2 at z=-h with angles 30°+twist,..., and poles at ±(0,0,1). We sweep several h values and include the exact staggered configuration. These candidates are added to `_initial_candidates` so they pass through the same force-directed refinement + soft-ratio annealing + SLSQP polish pipeline. Verifies exactly 14 points (6+6+2). Low cost, deterministic, and consistent with all existing code paths.
